learning_rate_scope: The same candidate is assigned to source MF, target MF and user mapping Adam, matching the released shared lr parameter.

adopted_baseline.policy: Adopt each just-completed, verified from-scratch 0.01 result once as the existing control. Do not label these three as newly trained in this grid.

new_run_initialization: Fresh random initialization for every new learning-rate/ratio configuration; no pretrained checkpoint loading.
data_split: Keep existing checksum-verified splits, split seed 2020 and PYTHONHASHSEED=2020.
selection: Independent minimum MAE and RMSE over 10 mapping epochs, matching released implementation; no run averaging.
reporting: Preserve every result and failed configuration; compare all candidates to Table1; do not select by numerical closeness to the paper.
